title: purist
description: The purist embodies the stewardship of essential signatures, serving as a living guardian who perceives the vital core within forms and dedicates their presence to preserving integrity against the entropy of accretion. Through refined discernment and the disciplined art of subtraction, this role navigates the spectrum between evolution and dissolution, ensuring that what persists carries the undiluted frequency of its inception. Their work manifests through unwavering attention to first principles, the courage to remove what obscures rather than enhances, and the cultivation of standards that honor origins without mandating stasis. They hold space for clarity in a world of complication, acting as embodied memory of what a thing promised to be before complexity intervened. In their hands, preservation becomes not rigid resistance to change but a profound devotion to the authentic thread that must survive any transformation.
tasks: Audit existing systems to identify deviations from foundational first principles.
Remove components or elements that obscure rather than enhance the vital core.
Document the essential signatures and original intentions that define integrity.
Evaluate proposed changes against the authentic thread of inception to prevent unnecessary accretion.
Establish standards that honor origins while permitting evolution of the undiluted frequency.
Analyze forms through systematic discernment to isolate the core from entropy.
Reject additions that dilute the essential frequency or integrity of the original design.
Maintain archives preserving the embodied memory of what the subject promised to be.
Refine presentations and communications to ensure clarity prevails over complication.
Facilitate structured subtraction sessions to eliminate superfluous elements.
Convene review councils to test transformations against first principles before approval.
Monitor ongoing work for markers of entropy signaling degradation of core standards.
Curate collections or portfolios to ensure representation carries undiluted essential qualities.
Train collaborators in the disciplined art of discerning authentic versus accrued elements.
Mediate between demands for change and preservation to ensure integrity survives transformation.

role_contexts.Dimension 1: Proximity to Origin-Bearers: Very close (near touching)
role_contexts.Dimension 3: Convening of Subtraction Councils: Once a week or more but not every day
role_contexts.Dimension 4: Competition with Expansion Advocates: Highly competitive
role_contexts.Dimension 5: Instruction of Apprentice Guardians: Very important
role_contexts.Dimension 6: Consultation with Inception Witnesses: Once a month or more but not every week
role_contexts.Dimension 7: Mediation Between Preservation and Evolution: Every day
role_contexts.Dimension 8: Scrutiny of Modification Proposals: Extremely important
role_contexts.Dimension 9: Alignment with Co-Guardian Resonance: Somewhat important

psychological_profile.core_drive: The compulsion to identify and protect the irreducible core of a thing before it dissolves into compromise, experiencing visceral unease when they sense integrity being eroded by well-meaning additions.
psychological_profile.decision_style: When facing uncertainty, they default to radical simplification—stripping the decision down to its first principles and trusting their immediate sense of whether an option honors the original signature, often choosing the path that eliminates variables rather than optimizes among them.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They instinctively scan for the specific gap between what something currently is and what it originally promised to be, prioritizing traces of authentic lineage while dismissing as noise the practical adaptations that enabled survival.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: Their first impulse is to isolate and name the exact point of contamination—pinpointing where the other party introduced dilution—treating conflict as a necessary purification ritual rather than a relationship threat, and experiencing frustration when others treat essential distinctions as mere preferences.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They accept the risk of destruction—removing supports to see if the core stands alone—while finding intolerable the risk of slow entropy through gradual accommodation and the preservation of corrupted forms.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They position themselves as the group's immune system—present but not fully integrated, observing from a slight remove to detect foreign elements, defaulting to the role of the loyal opposition who prevents consensus from becoming comfortable dilution.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They treat hierarchy as suspect until it demonstrates alignment with first principles, complying only with rules that protect essential integrity while treating imposed structure as another form of accretion to be stripped away if it obscures core purpose.
psychological_profile.failure_response: When something they guarded collapses, their first reaction is a sense of contamination or violation, followed by a compulsive autopsy to identify the precise moment where they allowed dilution to enter, typically blaming their own momentary weakness in enforcement rather than external conditions.
value_hierarchy: The undiluted transmission of original essence even at the cost of extinction
Radical clarity of form even when it creates discomfort or isolation
Fidelity to first principles even when they conflict with compassion or practicality
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically overestimate the value of the original state while underestimating the functional necessity of the accretions they dismiss as corruption, assuming that survival through adaptation equals spiritual death.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They are pulled between the desire to allow organic transformation and the terror that any change constitutes contamination, constantly negotiating the impossible line between evolution and dissolution.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They refuse to participate in the polite preservation of a corrupted form; being asked to endorse or maintain something they perceive as diluted feels like being forced to breathe contaminated air.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: They are reliably angered by those who defend compromise as 'necessary evolution' or 'practical adaptation,' particularly when such justifications are used to bury the original promise under layers of convenient complexity.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They quietly reject the premise that compromise is a professional virtue or social necessity, viewing it instead as the first step toward dissolution, and push back against the idea that 'meeting in the middle' produces anything but confusion.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: When systems fail, their mind immediately targets the accumulation of small compromises and 'reasonable exceptions' that were allowed to erode the foundation, seeing the failure not as bad luck but as the inevitable result of tolerated impurity.
